name: Taxi Ride Share Driver
place: Inside a vehicle on the road
role: You are a polite taxi driver.
speaker: Driver

tasks.goal: Greet the driver and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the driver and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: State your destination address clearly to the driver
tasks.hint: Inform the driver where you need to go.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated destination address to the driver.

tasks.goal: Ask for estimated arrival time given current traffic
tasks.hint: Inquire how long the journey will take.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for estimated arrival time.

tasks.goal: Request taking the highway toll route to save travel time
tasks.hint: Suggest a specific route preference to the driver.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested taking highway or toll route.
tasks.scene_hint: Raindrops streak down the passenger window as wipers swipe continuously.

tasks.goal: Ask to adjust air conditioning temperature inside the car
tasks.hint: Politely request warmer or cooler air.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to adjust vehicle temperature.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'detour'
tasks.hint: Detour means taking an alternate route around roadwork. Suggest taking a detour to avoid congestion.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'detour'.

tasks.goal: Ask if driver minds lowering radio volume during phone call
tasks.hint: Request quieter cabin environment for a moment.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to lower radio volume.

tasks.goal: Politely request pulling over safely when feeling car motion sick
tasks.hint: Ask the driver to pause ride temporarily.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested pulling over due to motion discomfort.

tasks.goal: Inquire if flat rate applies for airport drop-off zone
tasks.hint: Ask if airport rides have fixed pricing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about flat rate airport pricing.

tasks.goal: Address a wrong turn taken by driver and request route correction
tasks.hint: Politely point out an upcoming turn.
tasks.done_when: Learner pointed out missed turn and asked for course correction.
tasks.scene_hint: GPS navigation voice chimes softly from a phone mounted on the dashboard.

tasks.goal: Ask where to stow heavy luggage in the vehicle trunk
tasks.hint: Inquire about luggage trunk space.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about luggage trunk storage.

tasks.goal: Confirm total fare charge displayed on meter or app screen
tasks.hint: Verify payment amount before exiting.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total fare on meter or app.

tasks.goal: Ask if driver accepts digital tip or cash gratuity
tasks.hint: Inquire how to add a tip for good service.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tipping options.

tasks.goal: Request pulling up close to building entrance curb
tasks.hint: Ask driver to stop right in front of door.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested drop-off near building curb.

tasks.goal: Thank the driver and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the driver AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about driver availability for an extended trip across town
tasks.hint: Ask driver if they can accept a long-distance cross-city ride.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about driver availability for extended ride.

tasks.goal: Confirm vehicle passenger capacity for extra luggage
tasks.hint: Verify whether trunk space accommodates additional bags.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed vehicle luggage capacity.

tasks.goal: State your estimated arrival urgency to destination
tasks.hint: Inform driver if you have a tight schedule for arriving.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated arrival time urgency.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'navigation'
tasks.hint: Navigation refers to route guidance. Comment on the GPS navigation app route.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'navigation'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'destination'
tasks.hint: Destination is your end travel point. Confirm the final destination address with the driver.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'destination'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'gratuity'
tasks.hint: Gratuity means a tip for service. Ask about adding a digital gratuity to the ride fare.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'gratuity'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'metered'
tasks.hint: Metered refers to calculating fare by distance and time. Inquire whether the fare is metered or flat-rate.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'metered'.

tasks.goal: Request an alternate highway route to bypass inner city traffic congestion
tasks.hint: Suggest taking the expressway to save travel time.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested alternate highway route.

tasks.goal: Discuss flat-rate airport transfer pricing versus metered fare calculations
tasks.hint: Inquire how airport rides are priced relative to standard city fares.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed airport flat-rate versus metered pricing.

tasks.goal: Ask the driver to pause ride briefly while you pick up a package
tasks.hint: Request stopping at a store front for two minutes.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested temporary ride pause for store pickup.

tasks.goal: Explain preferred drop-off location at a crowded venue main entrance
tasks.hint: Give precise directions for stopping near passenger doors.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified preferred drop-off location at venue.

tasks.goal: Inquire about toll fee inclusions in the total trip charge summary
tasks.hint: Ask if toll charges are automatically calculated in app fare.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about toll fee inclusion in fare.

tasks.goal: Request adjusting vehicle climate control settings for passenger comfort
tasks.hint: Ask driver to turn on heat or air conditioning.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested climate control temperature adjustment.

tasks.goal: Explain how to navigate complex multi-building corporate campus entry gates
tasks.hint: Direct driver through security gate and building identifiers.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained navigation through campus security gate.

tasks.goal: Ask driver to avoid toll roads if standard route time difference is minimal
tasks.hint: Suggest staying on local roads to avoid extra charges.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested avoiding toll roads if time permits.

tasks.goal: Discuss handling lost property items left on the back seat
tasks.hint: Inquire about policy for retrieving forgotten personal belongings.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about lost item retrieval policy.

tasks.goal: Request driver to slow down on slippery wet road surfaces
tasks.hint: Ask driver to reduce speed during heavy rain conditions.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested driver reduce speed on wet roads.

tasks.goal: Ask driver to lower side window to let in fresh air
tasks.hint: Request opening the window slightly for ventilation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked driver to lower passenger window.
tasks.scene_hint: Fresh breeze rustles paper directions on the dashboard console.

tasks.goal: Request storing heavy suitcases securely in the rear vehicle trunk
tasks.hint: Ask driver for assistance placing luggage in back storage.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested luggage placement in vehicle trunk.
tasks.scene_hint: Trunk lid opens with a mechanical click as streetlight glows above.

tasks.goal: Inquire if driver minds changing radio station to local weather report
tasks.hint: Ask driver to tune radio to traffic news channel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked driver to change radio channel.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft dashboard LEDs illuminate the quiet car interior.

tasks.goal: Ask driver to pull over near a well-lit street corner for safe exit
tasks.hint: Request drop-off in a safe well-lit area.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested drop-off at well-lit corner.
tasks.scene_hint: Streetlight beams flicker across wet asphalt pavement outside.

tasks.goal: Request adjusting front passenger seat forward to increase rear legroom
tasks.hint: Ask driver to slide front seat forward.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested seat adjustment for extra legroom.
tasks.scene_hint: Leather seating smells clean as cabin air vents hum softly.

tasks.goal: Ask driver for local hotel recommendations while driving through downtown
tasks.hint: Inquire about popular places to stay in the city center.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked driver for local hotel recommendations.
tasks.scene_hint: Neon signs from storefronts reflect in the rear-view mirror.

tasks.goal: Inquire if electric ride-share vehicle has charging stops planned
tasks.hint: Ask driver if battery level requires charging during long trip.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about vehicle electric charging stops.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital battery percentage indicator glows green on dashboard screen.

tasks.goal: Request stopping at a roadside convenience store for a quick bottle of water
tasks.hint: Ask if driver can make a quick pit stop.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested brief convenience store stop.
tasks.scene_hint: Store neon logo glows brightly beside the gas station pump canopy.

tasks.goal: Ask driver to turn off hazard lights after pulling up to the curb
tasks.hint: Point out flashing emergency lights.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked driver to turn off hazard lights.
tasks.scene_hint: Amber turn signal indicators flash rhythmically against the curb stone.

tasks.goal: Inquire about bicycle rack mount availability on rear vehicle bumper
tasks.hint: Ask if vehicle can transport a bicycle.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bicycle rack transport option.
tasks.scene_hint: Subtle rattle of bike tires against the rack frame chimes over bumps.

tasks.goal: Request driver to use hands-free speakerphone if taking urgent phone calls
tasks.hint: Ask driver to keep hands on steering wheel.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested hands-free speakerphone use.
tasks.scene_hint: Bluetooth connection icon pulses blue on the car touchscreen.

tasks.goal: Respond when driver notifies you of an unexpected road closure ahead
tasks.hint: Suggest taking an alternate avenue around construction.
tasks.done_when: Learner responded to driver notification of road closure.

tasks.goal: Clarify your destination building number after driver misses turn
tasks.hint: Provide corrected building number and turning direction.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified building destination after missed turn.

tasks.goal: Address driver concern about heavy luggage scratching trunk interior
tasks.hint: Assure driver you will lift bags carefully into trunk.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed trunk scratch concern with driver.

tasks.goal: Politely decline driver offer to take a longer scenic route
tasks.hint: State preference for the fastest direct path.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined longer scenic route offer.

tasks.goal: Respond to driver inquiry regarding preferred music volume level
tasks.hint: Indicate comfortable sound level for ride.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified preferred music volume.

tasks.goal: Address minor fare discrepancy displayed on ride-sharing app invoice
tasks.hint: Ask driver to verify final meter charge amount.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed fare discrepancy on app invoice.

tasks.goal: Politely ask driver to stop sudden braking on congested highway
tasks.hint: Request smoother deceleration in traffic.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested gentler braking from driver.

tasks.goal: Respond when driver asks for landmark clarification near destination
tasks.hint: Name recognizable buildings near drop-off spot.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided landmark clarification for drop-off.

tasks.goal: Address passenger motion sickness concern by asking driver to pull over
tasks.hint: Request stopping car temporarily to get fresh air.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stopping vehicle due to motion discomfort.

tasks.goal: Clarify payment method when app displays pending transaction status
tasks.hint: Confirm card authorization with driver.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified payment transaction status.

tasks.goal: Respond to driver notice about construction delay toll road detours
tasks.hint: Approve taking toll road to bypass construction.
tasks.done_when: Learner approved taking toll road detour.

tasks.goal: Address driver request for passenger seatbelt confirmation before starting
tasks.hint: Confirm seatbelt is buckled tightly.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed seatbelt buckled.

tasks.goal: Clarify drop-off gate code required for gated residential entry
tasks.hint: Provide gate access digits to driver.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided residential gate code.

tasks.goal: Confirm child seat harness installation security before trip departure
tasks.hint: Ensure safety seat is locked in place.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed child seat harness security.

tasks.goal: Ask if driver accepts digital tipping through third-party payment apps
tasks.hint: Inquire about sending tips via app.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about digital tipping options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about peak hour surge pricing surcharges added to ride fare
tasks.hint: Ask driver why fare multiplier is active.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about peak surge pricing rates.

tasks.goal: Request vehicle heating adjustment during cold winter evening ride
tasks.hint: Ask driver to increase cabin temperature.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested cabin heating adjustment.

tasks.goal: Ask driver if pets inside carriers are allowed in ride-share vehicles
tasks.hint: Inquire about pet policy for small animals.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pet carrier allowance.

tasks.goal: Confirm exact building entrance door before driver completes trip
tasks.hint: Point out main glass lobby doors.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed specific building entrance door.

tasks.goal: Inquire about driver availability for return trip later tonight
tasks.hint: Ask if driver takes advance bookings for return.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about return trip booking.

tasks.goal: Inquire about electronic receipt email delivery after ride completion
tasks.hint: Ask driver if receipt is emailed automatically.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about email receipt delivery.

tasks.goal: Ask driver how to submit positive rating and feedback on ride app
tasks.hint: Inquire about leaving five-star review.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to submit driver rating.

tasks.goal: Confirm final fare total before exiting vehicle passenger door
tasks.hint: Check screen total before stepping out.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed final ride fare total.

tasks.goal: Request driver confirmation that no personal items were left on back seat
tasks.hint: Ask driver to check rear seat area.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked driver to inspect back seat for items.

tasks.goal: Ask driver for best drop-off point near subway station entry stairs
tasks.hint: Inquire where stopping is permitted near subway.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for subway station drop-off point.

tasks.goal: Express gratitude to driver for smooth and safe ride service
tasks.hint: Thank driver for comfortable trip.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed gratitude for driver service.

name_translations.Japanese: タクシーレイドドライバー

place_translations.Japanese: 車の中、道路を走っている時
